subtitle: Lesson 104 · Database Design Fundamentals

code:
CREATE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_LessonDemo_DemoID
ON dbo.LessonDemo (DemoID);
caption: Only ONE allowed per table — the data can only be physically sorted one way.

code:
CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_LessonDemo_Label
ON dbo.LessonDemo (Label);
caption: Sorted by Label, with pointers back to the real rows. A table can have MANY of these.
Adds DemoID to the index itself, without sorting on it — a query can be satisfied without touching the table.
The syntax companion to the clustered vs. nonclustered concepts from Chapter 10.

subtitle: An alias for another object, often across databases or servers.
